volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

pulseMode.tooltip: 0 Forward (high+fast first). 0.5 reverse then forward, peak in the middle. 1 reverse (peak at the end).

curvePolarity.tooltip: Pulse height invert next to A Start. + as drawn. − flips each height around (A Start + A End)/2. Same times.

edgeFade.tooltip: Edge Fade. On: when Stretch (or a negative End Delay) cuts the train, the last pulse before the cut fades by how far the edge is toward the next pulse, so pulses slide in and out instead of popping. Off: hard cut.

wave.tooltip: Trigger: single-sample pulses. Gate: 50% high between pulses. Saw/Ramp: naive ramp from one pulse to the next. TriSaw/Sine: one cycle starting and ending at 0. Pulse Left/Center/Right: -1/+1 pulse. Rect Sine: zero-mean |sin| hump. Each grain starts at a pulse and ends at the next.

seed.tooltip: Locks the antialiasing pattern. Same Seed = same offsets on every trigger. Change Seed for a different noise texture.

count.tooltip: Pulses in the train (one-way). Slider 1–1280, mid-skew (64 at the midpoint). Type above the slider for denser trains (DSP up to 16384).

spacing.tooltip: Time warp family. Curve 0 is even (linear) in every family. Expo is the original (e^(k u)-1)/(e^k-1). Harmonic mixes that linear spacing toward multiples of a base time (gaps 1τ, 2τ, 3τ…). Rational is rational_curve01.

curve.tooltip: Frequency/time curve. 0 even (linear). Expo: + gaps grow, − gaps shrink. Harmonic: |ƒ Crv|/10 mixes linear toward 1τ,2τ,3τ… (+) or the reverse (−). Rational: skew ±1 at the knob ends.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

interpolation.tooltip: Delay-line fractional read. Linear (default). Hidden — enable from the parameter visibility menu.

pingPong.tooltip: PingPong Off = parallel stereo delay. Left Right = L→R bounce. Left Middle Right = taps at T / 2T / 3T panned L, center, R.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note. Numer=0 → no delay. Examples: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×.

offset.tooltip: Static trim (ms) of the tempo-base delay on both taps: delay = tempoBase + Offset + LFO_Amp×lfo. Not LFO depth — that is LFO Amp. Negative shortens, positive lengthens. Sample-accurate — pitches when swept or MOD’d.

lfoStyle.tooltip: Shape of the built-in delay-time modulator. Parabol / Random Walk / FBM.

lfoRate.tooltip: LFO speed in Hz (0…20). Speed only — depth is LFO Amp (ms). Gold LFO L/R outs move whenever Rate > 0, even if Amp is 0.

lfoAmp.tooltip: How far the LFO moves delay time (ms) around (tempoBase + Offset). Default 25 ms is audible wow; 0 = tempoBase+Offset only (Rate still drives gold LFO outs). Unlike Delay Mod (fraction of delay time), this depth is absolute milliseconds.

lfoVariation.tooltip: Detunes L vs R LFO rates so the two delays don’t lock together.

lpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole lowpass in the feedback loop (darkens repeats). 0 Hz holds (closed); DSP caps at Nyquist. Slider min/max are guides only.

hpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole highpass in the feedback loop (thins mud / DC). Slider min/max are guides only; DSP caps at Nyquist.

hpfShelf.tooltip: Feedback HPF mix: dry + Shelf x (filtered - dry). 100% = full filter.

lpfShelf.tooltip: Feedback LPF mix: dry + Shelf x (filtered - dry). 100% = full filter.

feedback.tooltip: Feedback into the saturated tape loop. Saturate soft-clips. >1 can self-oscillate.

saturate.tooltip: Soft clip in the feedback path (tape grunge). Lower = harder saturation; higher = cleaner.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet mix on Mix L / Mix R.

seed.tooltip: LFO random (walk / FBM) seed. Same Seed = same modulation.

bpm.tooltip: This metronome's tempo (beats per minute). When BPM In is wired, that value is the tempo and this slider is ignored. Unwired uses this slider. Independent of other metronomes.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1.

beats.tooltip: Beats per bar for the click. Beat 1 = hi click (downbeat); other beats = lo click.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note. Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×.

mode.tooltip: Sync = follows the master playhead, so metronomes with the same BPM and Reset share beats. Free = runs its own phase from its last Reset. In both, a BPM change only changes speed from that moment (no phase jump).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level for gate and trigger outs.

upShape.tooltip: Rising glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

downShape.tooltip: Falling glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

upTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a higher target from the current value (any amplitude — Hz, CV, audio). 0 = instant.

downTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a lower target from the current value (any amplitude). 0 = instant.

bias.tooltip: Offset added before slew (0…1). Hidden by default — show it to step the target by hand.
